name: The Grassrivers
summary: Leonida's sprawling flooded wetland wilderness of sawgrass, murky mangrove channels, aggressive alligators, and high-speed airboats.
description: Inspired by the Florida Everglades, The Grassrivers represents the treacherous wild core of southern Leonida. Shallow mud banks and dense mangrove forests make conventional vehicles unusable, requiring specialized flat-bottom airboats. The region is home to dangerous wildlife, poacher camps, submerged wreckage, and hidden contraband drops.

seo.title: The Grassrivers: Swamps, Airboats & Alligators
seo.description: Full guide to The Grassrivers in GTA VI. Explore the Everglades wetlands, airboat locations, wildlife danger zones, and hidden caches.
